question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a grey present, Bob has a white present, Claire has a pink present, Dave has a brown present, Eve has a black present, Fred has a red present, and Gertrude has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) grey present
(B) white present
(C) pink present
(D) brown present
(E) black present
(F) red present
(G) purple present
solution:
Gift colors in each row are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: grey, white, pink, brown, black, red, purple.
1. Eve and Alice swap: black, white, pink, brown, grey, red, purple.
2. Alice and Fred swap: red, white, pink, brown, grey, black, purple.
3. Gertrude and Claire swap: red, white, purple, brown, grey, black, pink.
4. Claire and Dave swap: red, white, brown, purple, grey, black, pink.
5. Claire and Bob swap: red, brown, white, purple, grey, black, pink.
6. Fred and Claire swap: red, brown, black, purple, grey, white, pink.
7. Bob and Claire swap: red, black, brown, purple, grey, white, pink.
Eve has the grey present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
